teaser.en: A thorny-twigged terminalia with wood so tough it was used for the keels of dhows.
teaser.sw: Mwangati wenye vitawi vya miiba na mbao ngumu kiasi kwamba zilitumika kutengeneza mataruma ya majahazi.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa jenasi ya *Terminalia* wenye maphungo ga miya, na nyama za muhi huno ni nyifu sana hata kare zahumirwa kuhendera mikuku ya majahazi.

summary.en: Mwarambe is the purple-pod terminalia, a small tree of dry bush with winged purple-red fruits. Its hard, termite-resistant wood is used for building and once went into dhow keels.
summary.sw: Mwarambe ni mwangati, mti mdogo wa vichaka vikavu wenye matunda yenye mabawa ya rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu. Mbao zake ngumu zisizoliwa na mchwa hutumika katika ujenzi, na zamani zilitumika kutengeneza mataruma ya majahazi.
summary.dg: *Mwarambe* ni *purple-pod terminalia*, muhi mdide wa weruni kukavu wenye matunda genye mapha, ga rangi ya zambarau na kundu. Nyama za muhi huno ni nyifu na taziriwa ni malutswa; nkuhumirwa kudzengera, na kare zahumirwa kuhendera mikuku ya majahazi.

about.en: Mwarambe is a shrubby tree, 3 to 10 m tall, with a dense, rounded and often layered crown and long, drooping branches. The bark is grey and grooved. Its small leaves are clustered on short, spiky side twigs. Red buds open into spikes of cream, unpleasant-smelling, nectar-rich flowers, followed by eye-catching flat, winged, purple-red to brown fruits that stay on the tree.
about.sw: Mwarambe ni mti wa kichaka, wenye urefu wa m 3 hadi 10, wenye taji nzito ya mviringo ambayo mara nyingi huwa na matabaka, na matawi marefu yanayoning'inia. Gome lake ni la kijivu lenye mifereji. Majani yake madogo hujikusanya kwenye vitawi vifupi vyenye ncha kali vya pembeni. Vichipukizi vyekundu hufunguka kuwa vishada virefu vya maua ya rangi ya krimu, yenye harufu mbaya na yaliyojaa mbochi, yakifuatwa na matunda bapa yenye mabawa yanayovutia macho, ya rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu hadi kahawia, yanayobaki mtini.
about.dg: *Mwarambe* ni muhi dza chitsaka, wa urefu wa mita 3 hadi 10. Dzuluye kuna makodza manji ganarundikana dza mviringo, mara nyinji ngazi-ngazi, na pandaze ni nyire na zinabwadzika photsi. Gophare ni ra rangi ya ivu na rina mifuo. Makodzage ni madide, na ganamera phamwenga dzulu ya maphungo mafupi ga kanda genye ntsa dza miya. Vimea vya kundu vinavuguka na kulavya maruwa ga rangi ya maziya ganayomera phamwenga dzulu ya mlita mure; maruwa higo gana arufu mbii na madzi manji ga mtswano. Bada ya phapho kunakpwedza matunda manono ga kulola, ga sambamba, genye mapha, ga rangi ya zambarau na kundu hadi rangi ya dongo, na ganasala muhini.

where.en: It grows in dry forest and bushland, often near rivers or seasonal watercourses, and on the coast also on saline soils.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu na vichakani, mara nyingi karibu na mito au mikondo ya maji ya msimu, na pwani pia kwenye udongo wenye chumvi.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani makavu na weruni, mara nyinji phephi na miho au njira za madzi ganayokpwedza wakati wa mvula tu, na pwani piya unamera kpwenye ulongo wenye munyu.

uses.en: ICRAF records hard, tough, termite-resistant wood, heavier than many terminalias, used for house construction, poles, posts, tool handles, furniture and dhow keels, because it resists salt water and borers. It also gives firewood and charcoal, fodder from the fruit, mulch and medicine. Beehives are often hung in its branches.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaripoti mbao ngumu na imara zisizoliwa na mchwa, nzito kuliko za Terminalia nyingi, zinazotumika kujenga nyumba, kwa nguzo, milingoti, mipini ya zana, samani na mataruma ya majahazi, kwa sababu zinastahimili maji ya chumvi na wadudu watobozi. Pia hutoa kuni na mkaa, lishe ya mifugo kutokana na matunda, matandazo na dawa. Mizinga ya nyuki mara nyingi huning'inizwa kwenye matawi yake.
uses.dg: ICRAF inaandika kukala nyama za muhi huno ni nyifu sana na taziriwa ni malutswa, na piya ni ndziho kuriko za mihi minji ya *Terminalia*. Nkuhumirwa kudzengera nyumba, kuhendera nguzo, miphini ya vyombo vya kazi, fanicha na mikuku ya majahazi, kpwa sababu tazibanangwa ni madzi ga munyu wala ni adudu anaokobola mbao. Piya unalavya kuni na makala, matundage ni chakurya cha mifugo, unalavya vitu vya kubwiningiza ulongo munda, na ni muhaso. Mizinga ya nyuchi mara nyinji nkubwadzikpwa pandazeni.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwarambe but gives no meaning or shared names. ICRAF gives the Swahili name as mwangati or mwangati punda, and the Giriama name as Mwanga, which in Digo is a different tree, the river terminalia (Terminalia sambesiaca). In English it is the purple-pod terminalia; its scientific name is Terminalia prunioides.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwarambe lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine. ICRAF inatoa jina la Kiswahili kama mwangati au mwangati punda, na jina la Kigiriama kama Mwanga, ambalo kwa Kidigo ni mti mwingine, *river terminalia* (Terminalia sambesiaca). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *purple-pod terminalia*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Terminalia prunioides.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mwarambe*, ela kalavya manage, wala madzina ganayohumirwa piya ni luga zanjina. ICRAF inalavya dzina ra Chiswahili kukala *mwangati* au *mwangati punda*, na dzina ra Chigiryama kukala *Mwanga*, ambaro kpwa Chidigo ni dzina ra muhi wanjina, *river terminalia* (*Terminalia sambesiaca*). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *purple-pod terminalia*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Terminalia prunioides*.

reason.en: Another hard-wooded tree of dry bush
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa mbao ngumu wa vichaka vikavu
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa weruni kukavu wenye nyama nyifu
